text:
incidentbot: 🚨 High Ack Entropy: notify-webhook-proxy showing elevated ACK latency and intermittent 429s to downstream pager vendors. Potential customer exposure to delayed pages. Suppressing duplicates for now.

maria: seeing a spike in `POST /hooks/pager` 5xx->429 chain around 14:02 UTC. logs attached (tail):
```
2026-03-18T14:01:55Z notify-webhook-proxy req_id=ab12 status=200 vendor_ack_ms=120
2026-03-18T14:02:03Z notify-webhook-proxy req_id=ab13 status=429 vendor_retry_after=2
2026-03-18T14:02:04Z notify-webhook-proxy req_id=ab14 status=502 upstream timeout
2026-03-18T14:02:10Z notify-webhook-proxy req_id=ab15 status=200 vendor_ack_ms=950
```

kevin: ops-oncall, you're up — do you want me to start fallback to SMS relay?

ops-oncall: on it. I'm going to toggle `notify-routing.fallback.experimental_sms=true` for high-priority routes.

devex-sre: heads up — the proxy has a new rate-limit guard we rolled last week. looks like the guard is treating vendor 429s as terminal and squelching retries, causing our suppression to kick in.

sophie: customer support flagged delayed pages for two customers in EU region (acct: acme-co, acct: halo-health). they timed out confirmation flows.

jack: opening incident ticket INC-2026-0318-01 and linking support threads. customer impact = delayed pages (timed out sign-in links).

maria: reproducer locally: hammer vendor endpoint with 50 rps and watch `ack_ms` variance. Fix candidate is to treat vendor 429 as transient with exponential backoff rather than immediate suppression.

kevin: performing a low-risk config flip: re-enable vendor-retry-on-429 in proxy (flag: `retry_on_429=true`) and lower duplicate-suppress window from 30s -> 10s for affected routes. Will monitor.

incidentbot: Config change detected: `notify-proxy:retry_on_429` => true by kevin at 14:08 UTC.

maria: pushed temporary tweak in staging and ran synthetic throughputs, looks promising — ack_ms drop from median 700ms -> 120ms after retries enabled.

ops-oncall: rolling change to canary (1 node) in prod now. `kubectl apply -f canary-notify-proxy.yaml`

pagerbot: FYI vendor-side reported they were throttling due to a transient surge from one downstream integrator. They lifted throttle at 14:12 UTC.

kevin: canary looks healthy, no increased error budget alerts. promoting to 30% traffic.

sophie: support reports pages resumed for acme-co and halo-health at ~14:15 UTC. waiting on customer confirmation for full remediation.

maria: follow-up: need a durable change — two actions: 1) change proxy semantics to treat 429 as retryable with jittered backoff up to X retries, 2) add vendor-429 as a distinct metric in Console (counter + SLO annotation).

devex-sre: agree. also propose adding a short-term override to pause duplicate suppression when vendor ack variance > 500ms so we don't cancel legitimate retries.

jack: capturing all that in the incident ticket. I'll assign postmortem owners: maria (root cause & mitigation), kevin (rollout & guardrails), devex-sre (metrics/alerts), ops-oncall (runbook updates).

incidentbot: Customer exposure estimate: ~2 customers affected, ~7 delayed pages, no confirmed missed escalations.

ops-oncall: adding manual SMS fallback to the two impacted account routes while we finalize fix. command I ran: `redwoodctl routes set-fallback --route acme-co --mode sms --expires 2026-03-18T15:00:00Z`

maria: put a short snippet for the postmortem: root cause = aggressive duplicate-suppression interacting with vendor 429 semantics introduced by last week's proxy change.

kevin: rolling out full fix to prod now (feature branch -> progressively roll to 100% over 10m). will watch `notify.vendor_ack_latency` and `notify.429_rate` dashboards.

sophie: customers confirmed resolution via support chat. Marking customer impact as mitigated.

jack: incident declared RESOLVED at 14:26 UTC after rollback/patch and fallbacks. Postmortem ETA EOD tomorrow.

maria: follow-ups in postmortem: add dedicated unit tests for 429 handling, update runbook to include `retry_on_429` toggle, and add SLO note for vendor throttles.

devex-sre: I'll add the alert: `if vendor_429_rate > 0.5% and ack_ms_p95 > 500ms -> page #inc-team oncall`.

kevin: thanks all. quick retro note: let's avoid using suppression windows as the only signal for retries — we need a separation between dedupe and transient vendor failures. :+1:

incidentbot: Incident log appended to INC-2026-0318-01.

pagerbot: Confirmed no further vendor throttles after 14:30 UTC.

jack: closing slack thread, will ping when postmortem is published. :memo:
